mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals imminent monetary tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals an overheating economy requiring aggressive monetary policy, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates rate hikes and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rose and UNRATE fell, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets price in sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions with rising HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend over the prior 3 months indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings outlook improves.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an excessively tight labor market that triggers inflation concerns and central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as risk-off sentiment dominates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been below 3.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction permits (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals demand-driven housing boom amid manufacturing weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer sectors outperform.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rose and INDPRO fell, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic supply chain recovery, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals improving manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-pandemic supply chain recovery with INDPRO above 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
